propositions: Documentation must explain that sync.remote accepts s3://bucket/prefix remotes served by the optional git-remote-s3 helper and cross-link to the new backend guide.

A new operator guide (docs/s3-backend.md) must document git-remote-s3 installation (minimum v0.3.2), SSE-KMS bucket and IAM/CMK setup, git remote configuration, the AWS credentials trust boundary, and auto-doctor stale-lock self-heal behavior with 60s TTL.

A new ADR (docs/adr/0093-s3-ticket-store-backend.md) must record the decision to use git-remote-s3 as a shell-out layer, accept SSE-KMS encryption, employ merge-based auto-doctor instead of upstream's interactive doctor, and reject TTL lowering.

The ADR marker (docs/adr/.numbers/0093) and regenerated ADR index (docs/adr/README.md) must be committed, and both gen_adr_index.py --check and check_adr_numbers.py must pass to enforce bijection and no dangling cross-references.
Both new pages must be discoverable from docs/README.md: the s3-backend.md guide linked directly and ADR 0093 discoverable via the generated docs/adr/README.md index.
